reason: A DeepSeek Harness runtime guard that tracks untrusted tool-result provenance, gates configured privileged calls, and refuses detected credential or canary material in configured egress arguments.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的运行时防护插件，可根据不可信工具结果追踪污染状态、拦截特权调用，并拒绝向指定外发工具传递检测到的凭据或金丝雀内容。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness runtime guard that tracks taint from untrusted tool results, gates configured privileged calls, and refuses detected credentials or canaries in selected egress arguments.

capabilities: Marks agent state after configured untrusted tool results
Gates configured privileged tool calls based on provenance and detected signals
Scans configured egress tool arguments for credential patterns and can refuse matching calls
Annotates selected untrusted tool results as quoted data
Observes tool names, arguments, and text results passing through the harness
